name: idle-compact
description: Compacts the session after an idle period, before the prompt cache expires; tunable live

idleSeconds.title: Idle seconds
idleSeconds.description: How long to wait after a turn ends before compacting (default 1200)

minTokens.title: Min tokens
minTokens.description: Skip compaction when the context is smaller than this (default 120000)

minGrowth.title: Min growth
minGrowth.description: After a compaction, skip until the context has grown this much past its size after the compaction (default 40000)

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Optional focus for the compaction summary

announce.title: Announce
announce.description: Comma list of log, toast, notify, prompt (default log,toast,notify)
